text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My three years with Espoir City
have come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And starting today,
a brand-new year begins for both of us.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Are you ready?
choice_data_list: Yeah, what about Espo?
Yeah, how about you, Espo?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I was done a long time ago.
...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...So,
how long have you been planning this?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That you... That I'm an Umamusume far too massive for you to handle.
choice_data_list: ...Around the time of the Mile CS Nambu Hai, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You were weirdly stubborn back then, y'know.
Refusing to budge, insisting that I had to be the one to set the goal.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Guess I'll have more chances like that from now on.
Deciding for myself... and seeing it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That sounds like such a pain...!
choice_data_list: Even so, I know you can do it.
Even so, I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I already know that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I can do it...
Just watch me from behind.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't blink for even a second.
Watch them until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Hey.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Even before my debut, I went and told everyone in my class.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a crazy-strong horse girl.
Strong enough that I don't even really need a Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Delivering on my word like that... pretty impressive, huh?
choice_data_list: Hahaha, so you can even see the future, huh
Ahaha, to think you can even foresee the future.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Crazy, isn't it!
To think she even has this kind of power.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm, like, legit amazing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Still... when I look back on this moment later,
I bet I'll feel totally refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Your training was brutal, you know!
Race walking, suddenly telling me to beat every single record... it was all just weird-ass training!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "You're stubborn as hell, but then you lose confidence out of nowhere—you're a real pain in the ass!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Just thinking that it starts all over again tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Starting tomorrow, you say—...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow is...—
choice_data_list: You'll still be strong tomorrow and beyond
You'll still be strong starting tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: No matter where you go or who you team up with, you're a splendid Umamusume.
No matter where you go or who you team up with, you're a magnificent Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me what I already know...!
choice_data_list: I'll keep watching you as you spread your wings
I'll keep watching you as you spread your wings and soar.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, keep cheering for me.
...Forever...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Stand in awe of what I can do!
Be proud of it for the rest of your life!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who's beside me!
Even if there's no one by my side!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I am who I am! A strong horse girl!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're the one who picked me! I'm the Umamusume you raised...!
choice_data_list: ...You're the one who chose, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Thank you for choosing me as your Trainer.
Thank you for having me as your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...gh—
Ah, dammit—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you dare cry, dammit...!! Not in a place like this...!
choice_data_list: The one crying here is you, isn't it...!
The one crying is you, aren't you...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Like hell...! That's my line, you bastard...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dammit... To hell with this...!
...Hey! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
These three years were so much fun!
—They really, truly were!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even if I wanted to forget these days, how could I?!
Every single memory with ya is right here inside me!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's why the today that we both chose
will definitely turn out to be the right answer someday!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "I'll show ya! Just watch me!!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: So――see ya later!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Thank you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Cherry blossom petals dance in the air
as I watch a parting silhouette walk away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—the season of cherry blossoms comes around again.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Are those... the three years spent with Espoir City,
written down in that "notebook"?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: "...Your notebook wasn't just a textbook, Trainer; it was also the design document for the 'Strongest Umamusume,' wasn't it?"
choice_data_list: Ahaha... Embarrassingly enough...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Not at all!
Your teaching methods using that textbook
have inspired so many others as well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Her training method diverged a bit from the established norms of mainstream dirt racing... which surely gave those involved with dirt tracks much food for thought.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Even if the talents look similar from an outside perspective,
the golden glow within each talent... is uniquely individual, you see.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"You should have learned from them.
There are countless ways to nurture talent."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Things that seemed so obvious...
Yet were actually profoundly important.
choice_data_list: ...It's all thanks to Espoir.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
“...... But still,
you two parted ways.”

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"For this very day,
—the day I held hope would come."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLATTER-RATTLE!!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —I'm baaack!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.
choice_data_list: ...Espo.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
It starts today, right?
Espoir City is beginning her full-scale preparations for the Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: "She left your side and gained experience under a renowned instructor."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"...And today,
you and Espoir City-san
will reunite as a duo."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —'Cause I already made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I've "met all kinds of people,
and learned from them", ya know!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: "As the strongest Umamusume in your own eyes," so that you can "win any race."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: We're going for the win, Breeders' Cup.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'm gonna win every single one of these awesome races.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...As just another fan,
I'm truly looking forward to seeing you two shine together once more.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, all done seeing them off?
Alright, let's get back to it and reboot.
choice_data_list: Never thought the day would come when I'd get to train you again.
To think the day would come when I could guide you once again...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's my line.
Teaming up with you again of all people...
choice_data_list: Even though you came back on your own accord...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You pickin' a fight?
'Cause I'll take you on, punk.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“...Everything about you, right down to stuff like that,
is why I can't stand you.”
choice_data_list: I don't dislike you at all.
It's not like I dislike you or anything.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
Alright, time for training.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do it. Together.
Yeah, I'll do it. Together with you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
May I ask you just one last question?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to know the true identity
of the "Strongest Umamusume" that you wrote about.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Is that existence truly... a lie?
Is there really... no real-life model?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The strongest Umamusume."
Such an Umamusume was never supposed to exist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, now I can say that they "exist."
Because—they are undeniably right here.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?
choice_data_list: You really are a strong Umamusume.
You're a strong Uma Musume.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Stop stating the obvious, dumbass.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I understand.
The girl standing right before me is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's the strongest Umamusume in my eyes.
